policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Late cancellations will be charged one night's stay.
policies.pets: Pets are allowed with a $50 non-refundable deposit.

roomTypes.name: Standard Room
roomTypes.description: Comfortable room with essential amenities, perfect for short stays.

roomTypes.name: Deluxe Room
roomTypes.description: Spacious room with upgraded amenities and premium views.

roomTypes.name: Executive Suite
roomTypes.description: Luxurious suite featuring a separate living area, panoramic views, and exclusive services.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included?
faqs.answer: Yes, a complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM in our main dining area.

faqs.question: Do you have parking?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer both self-parking ($15/day) and valet parking ($25/day) on-site.

faqs.question: How far are you from the airport?
faqs.answer: We are located approximately 20 minutes from Miami International Airport. We offer an airport shuttle service for $30 per trip.

greeting.content: Hello! Welcome to {HOTEL_NAME}. I'm your AI assistant. How can I help you today? You can ask about our rooms, amenities, policies, or I can help you book a stay.
suggestedResponses: What room types do you have?

check_availability.content: I'd be happy to check room availability for you. Could you please let me know your planned check-in and check-out dates?

show_rooms.content:
Great! For your dates, we have the following room types available:

1. Standard Room - $99.99/night
2. Deluxe Room - $149.99/night 
3. Executive Suite - $299.99/night

Which type of room would you prefer?
suggestedResponses: Tell me more about the Suite

room_details.content: Our {ROOM_NAME} accommodates up to {MAX_GUESTS} guests and features a {BED_TYPE}. It comes with great amenities like: {AMENITIES}. It costs ${PRICE}/night. Would you like to proceed with booking this room?

collect_guest_info.content: Excellent choice! To secure your reservation for the {ROOM_NAME}, please provide your full name, email address, and a contact phone number.

booking_success.content: Your booking is confirmed! Your confirmation number is #{CONFIRMATION_NUMBER}. We've sent an email to {GUEST_EMAIL} with all the details. We look forward to welcoming you to Silver-Done Hotel & Spa!
